name: Carousel
summary: A swipeable set of slides — onboarding, a feature tour, a gallery — rendered through the shared Carousel.
lead: Carousel carries slide transitions, autoplay and dot/arrow controls, and keeps antd's built-in motion — too much to rebuild as a web component, so it stays on real Ant: antd v6 (React) and ant-design-vue v4 (Vue), both themed once by the shared carouselTheme. Two implementations, one DS V3 look. This is the composite half of the hybrid.

spec.label: Arrows
spec.value: opt-in prev/next via the arrows prop

props.name: dotPosition
props.desc: Where the dots sit relative to the track

props.name: afterChange
props.desc: Fires after the active slide changes

whenToUse.when: a small, ordered set of equally-weighted panels the user can browse at their own pace
named sections the user jumps between directly, not in sequence
a linear process with a clear start and finish

opinion.note: Keep it to a handful of slides and always show the dots so people know there is more. Autoplay only for ambient galleries — never for content people need to read.
opinion.dsv3: COVERED — antd v6 Carousel themed once by carouselTheme; matrix: dotPosition (top/bottom/left/right) · effect (scrollx slide/fade) · autoplay (on/off) · arrows (on/off) · dots (on/off), all live in the playground. Verified via Figma search_design_system against the DS V3 Carousel set (Carousel-wrapper) — the DS themes antd's Carousel rather than re-implementing it, so the antd v6 API is the variant reference.

snippets.label: HTML
snippets.note: Composite has no framework-free element, so its paste-and-run form is a CDN-React page — React + antd load from a CDN and mount on open, consuming the same shared carouselTheme. No build step.

codeNote: React and Vue are two real vendor libraries at two Ant generations — they can't share a primitive. They converge via the same carouselTheme; residual drift is caught by visual regression.

conformance.$about: Measured by qa.mjs against the RENDERED UI (getComputedStyle via headless CDP). Composite shown as a CDN-React page mounted at #react-root; the measure reads the real antd v6 carousel bound to carouselTheme.
